Committee: State Government
Sponsor: South
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 01/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 76 as introduced repeals Act 2021-227 of the 2021 Regular Session under Article 3 of Chapter 26B of Title 8, relating to student athletes and compensation for use of a student athletes name, image, or likeness. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
